scope: Fresh clearance preparation result and received settings-issuer cleanup window. Not coherent missing-record/owner-ready transport.
defects: Fresh startup ignored CortexClearSettingsApply PREPARE results, including PENDING from exact predecessor restoration. It could admit a worker whose old canonical settings context still blocked application.

CortexClearSettingsRelease group pending window was keyed by current clear generation/epoch and recreated serverTime+30 whenever either changed. The same unresolved old actor issuer could receive a renewed automatic cleanup window. Existing cleanup callbacks themselves retained their window, but re-admission could replace it.
implementation: Count every original-authority actor preparation, including fresh starts. Fresh startup requires ABSENT/PREPARED; other results use ACTOR_PREPARATION_UNAVAILABLE and existing scoped release before worker startup. Resume retains preceding ADOPTED/known-settings/motion checks.

New actor CBE_Cortex_ClearSettingRetireUntil is [settingsIssuer,originalUntil]. Same-issuer received windows survive group pending-generation rebinding; the group window uses that originalUntil rather than serverTime+30. A distinct issuer may establish its own window.

Malformed nonempty windows and received same-issuer expired windows refuse before automatic ActorSettings RELEASE; no new window is minted from those records. Exact successful restoration removes only its captured matching marker.
Uses existing shared cleanup service, existing at-most-eight preparation roster and unchanged one-actor cleanup callback. No new worker, scan, movement, target, group membership or fresh native task.
